title: Identification of 2,4,5-trisubstituted-2,4-dihydro-3H-1,2,4-triazol-3-one-based small molecules as selective BRD9 binders.
authors: Colarusso, Ester; Ceccacci, Sara; Monti, Maria Chiara; Gazzillo, Erica; Giordano, Assunta; Chini, Maria Giovanna; Ferraro, Maria Grazia; Piccolo, Marialuisa; Ruggiero, Dafne; Irace, Carlo; Terracciano, Stefania; Bruno, Ines; Bifulco, Giuseppe; Lauro, Gianluigi
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦BRD9溴结构域小分子抑制剂发现，涉及蛋白-小分子对接与结合评估，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Targeting bromodomain-containing protein 9 (BRD9) represents a promising strategy for the development of new agents endowed with anticancer properties. With this aim, a set of 2,4,5-trisubstituted-2,4-dihydro-3H-1,2,4-triazol-3-one-based compounds was investigated following a combined approach that relied on in silico studies, chemical synthesis, biophysical and biological evaluation of the most promising items. The protocol was initially based on molecular docking experiments, accounting a library of 1896 potentially synthesizable items tested in silico against the bromodomain of BRD9. A first set of 21 compounds (1-21) was selected and the binding on BDR9 was assessed through AlphaScreen assays. The obtained results disclosed compounds 17 and 20 able to bind BRD9 in the submicromolar range (IC(50) = 0.35 +/- 0.18 muM and IC(50) = 0.14 +/- 0.03 muM, respectively) showing a promising selectivity profile when tested against further nine bromodomains. Taking advantage of 3D structure-based pharmacophore models, additional 10 derivatives were selected in silico for the synthetic step and binding assessment, highlighting seven compounds (22, 23, 25, 26, 28, 29, 31) able to selectively bind BRD9 among different bromodomains. The ability of the identified BRD9 binders to cross artificial membranes in vitro was also assessed, revealing a very good passive permeability profile. Preliminary studies were carried out on a panel of healthy and cancer human cell lines to explore the biological behavior of the selected compounds, disclosing a moderate activity and significant selectivity profile towards leukaemia cells. These results highlighted the applicability of the reported multidisciplinary approach for accelerating the selection of promising items and for driving the chemical synthesis of novel selective BRD9 binders. Moreover, the low molecular weight of the reported 2,4,5-trisubstituted-2,4-dihydro-3H-1,2,4-triazol-3-one-based BRD9 binders suggests the possibility for further exploring the chemical space in order to obtain new analogues with improved potency.
abstract_zh: 靶向含溴结构域蛋白9（BRD9）代表了一种开发具有抗癌性质新药的有前景策略。为此，本研究采用结合计算机模拟研究、化学合成、生物物理及生物学评估的综合方法，对一组基于2,4,5-三取代-2,4-二氢-3H-1,2,4-三唑-3-酮的化合物进行了考察。该方案最初基于分子对接实验，针对BRD9的溴结构域，对包含1896个潜在可合成化合物的库进行了计算机模拟测试。首先筛选出21个化合物（1-21），并通过AlphaScreen实验评估了它们与BRD9的结合能力。所得结果揭示了化合物17和20能够在亚微摩尔范围内结合BRD9（IC(50) = 0.35 ± 0.18 μM 和 IC(50) = 0.14 ± 0.03 μM），在针对另外九个溴结构域测试时显示出有前景的选择性特征。利用基于三维结构的药效团模型，额外选择了10个衍生物进行计算机模拟合成步骤和结合评估，其中七个化合物（22、23、25、26、28、29、31）能够在不同溴结构域中选择性结合BRD9。还评估了所识别BRD9结合剂在体外穿越人工膜的能力，显示出非常好的被动渗透性特征。在健康及癌性人类细胞系面板上进行了初步研究，以探索所选化合物的生物学行为，结果显示出中等活性以及对白血病细胞显著的的选择性特征。这些结果突显了所报告的多学科方法在加速选择有前景化合物和指导新型选择性BRD9结合剂化学合成方面的适用性。此外，所报告的基于2,4,5-三取代-2,4-二氢-3H-1,2,4-三唑-3-酮的BRD9结合剂具有低分子量，这提示了进一步探索化学空间以获得具有改进效力的新类似物的可能性。
